d.ko: From the creators of Angel Beats! and CLANNAD, Key, comes their latest emotional, award-winning journey. Follow protagonist Takahara Hairi as he travels to the secluded island Torishirojima, where he rediscovers what it means to enjoy summer vacation.
d.en: From the creators of Angel Beats! and CLANNAD, Key, comes their latest emotional, award-winning journey. Follow protagonist Takahara Hairi as he travels to the secluded island Torishirojima, where he rediscovers what it means to enjoy summer vacation.
d.zh:
「唯有那片炫目，始终未曾忘却。」
由创作出「CLANNAD」等名作的游戏品牌Key带来的一款文字冒险游戏。
「暑假」「与伙伴的盛夏回忆」「乡愁」
在远离尘嚣的小岛上，与伙伴共度夏日的时光，谈场盛夏的恋爱。
这是夏日的故事。
无法忘怀，也不能忘怀的夏日回忆。
